articles.title_en: Exchange Rate Dynamics and Monetary Spillovers with Imperfect Financial Markets
articles.title_cn: 不完全金融市场下的汇率动态与货币溢出效应
articles.abstract_en: We develop a quantitative model with imperfections in domestic and international financial markets that generates strong effects of U.S. monetary policy on emerging markets (EMs). Financial imperfections prevent arbitrage both between local EM lending and borrowing rates, and between local-currency and dollar borrowing rates. An adverse feedback effect between financial health and external conditions amplifies the domestic “financial accelerator,” leading to large cross-border spillovers of U.S. monetary policy shocks. The model implies a link between uncovered interest parity violations and local credit spreads, a prediction we show the data strongly supports. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含国内和国际金融市场不完善性的定量模型，该模型能够产生美国货币政策对新兴市场（EMs）的强烈影响。金融不完善性阻碍了本地新兴市场贷款与借款利率之间以及本币与美元借款利率之间的套利。金融健康与外部条件之间的不利反馈效应放大了国内“金融加速器”，导致美国货币政策冲击产生大规模跨境溢出。该模型暗示了无抛补利率平价偏离与本地信用利差之间的联系，我们展示的数据强烈支持这一预测。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接旁获取。

articles.abstract_en: We study a large currency cross-section using asset pricing methods that account for omitted-variable and measurement-error biases. First, we show that the pricing kernel includes at least three latent factors that resemble (but are not identical to) a strong U.S. “dollar” factor and two weak high Sharpe ratio “carry” and “momentum” slope factors. Evidence for an additional “value” factor is weaker. Second, using this pricing kernel, we find that only a small fraction of the over 100 nontradable candidate factors considered have a statistically significant risk premium, mostly relating to volatility, uncertainty, and liquidity conditions, rather than macro variables. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用考虑遗漏变量和测量误差偏差的资产定价方法研究一个大型货币截面。首先，我们表明定价核包含至少三个潜在因子，它们类似于（但不完全相同）一个强劲的美国“美元”因子和两个弱的高夏普比率“套利”和“动量”斜率因子。关于额外“价值”因子的证据较弱。其次，使用这个定价核，我们发现所考虑的超过100个不可交易候选因子中只有一小部分具有统计显著的风险溢价，主要与波动性、不确定性和流动性条件有关，而非宏观变量。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁边找到。

articles.title_en: Committee-Based Blockchains as Games between Opportunistic Players and Adversaries
articles.title_cn: 基于委员会的区块链：机会主义参与者与 adversaries 之间的博弈
articles.abstract_en: We study consensus in a protocol capturing in a simplified manner the major features of the majority of Proof of Stake blockchains. A committee is formed; one member proposes a block; and the others can check its validity and vote for it. Blocks with a majority of votes are produced. When an invalid block is produced, the stakes of the members who voted for it are “slashed.” Profit-maximizing members interact with adversaries seeking to disrupt consensus. When slashing is limited, free-riding and moral-hazard lead to invalid blocks in equilibrium. We propose a protocol modification producing only valid blocks in equilibrium. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一种协议中的共识，该协议以简化方式捕捉了大多数权益证明区块链的主要特征。形成一个委员会；一名成员提出一个区块；其他成员可以检查其有效性并投票支持。产生获得多数票的区块。当产生无效区块时，投票支持该区块的成员的权益将被“削减”。追求利润最大化的成员与试图破坏共识的 adversaries 互动。当削减有限时，搭便车和道德风险导致均衡中出现无效区块。我们提出一种协议修改，在均衡中仅产生有效区块。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接旁边获取。

articles.title_en: Dynamic Equilibrium with Costly Short-Selling and Lending Market
articles.title_cn: 成本性卖空与借贷市场的动态均衡
articles.abstract_en: We develop a dynamic model of costly stock short-selling and lending market and obtain implications that simultaneously support many empirical regularities related to short-selling. In our model, investors’ belief disagreement leads to shorting demand, whereby short-sellers pay shorting fees to borrow stocks from lenders. Our main novel results are as follows. Short interest is positively related to shorting fee and predicts stock returns negatively. Higher short-selling risk can be associated with lower stock returns and less short-selling activity. Stock volatility is increased under costly short-selling. An application to GameStop episode yields implications consistent with observed patterns.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个成本性股票卖空与借贷市场的动态模型，并获得了同时支持许多与卖空相关的经验规律的含义。在我们的模型中，投资者的信念分歧导致卖空需求，卖空者支付卖空费用向贷方借入股票。我们的主要新颖结果如下。卖空兴趣与卖空费用正相关，并对股票收益产生负向预测。较高的卖空风险可能与较低的股票收益和较少的卖空活动相关。在成本性卖空下，股票波动性增加。应用于GameStop事件的结果与观察到的模式一致。

articles.title_en: Seller Debt in Acquisitions of Private Firms: A Security Design Approach
articles.title_cn: 收购私营企业中的卖方债务：一种证券设计方法
articles.abstract_en: We propose a security design model in which a potential acquirer approaches a firm with a value-add plan. The target has a single owner, who possesses private information: he alone knows whether his firm is compatible with the plan. The owner agrees that the acquirer will add value but believes that the value-add will not be as much as what the acquirer expects. Although the acquirer can choose any monotone limited liability security to offer along with cash, we show that, under general conditions, any security that is employed always takes the form of nonrecourse debt provided by the seller. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出一个证券设计模型，其中潜在收购方带着增值计划接近一家企业。目标企业有单一所有者，他拥有私人信息：只有他自己知道其企业是否与该计划兼容。所有者同意收购方将增加价值，但认为增值不会像收购方预期的那样多。尽管收购方可以选择任何单调有限责任证券与现金一起提供，但我们表明，在一般条件下，任何使用的证券总是采取卖方提供的无追索权债务的形式。作者已提供互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接旁边获取。

articles.title_en: Common Venture Capital Investors and Startup Growth
articles.title_cn: 共同风险投资人与初创企业成长
articles.abstract_en: We exploit the staggered introduction of liability waivers when investors hold stakes in conflicting business opportunities as a shock to venture capital (VC) investment and director networks. After the law changes, we find increases in within-industry VC investment and common directors serving on startup boards. Despite the potential for rent extraction, same-industry startups inside VC portfolios benefit by raising more capital, failing less, and exiting more successfully. VC directors serving on other startup boards are the primary mechanism associated with positive outcomes, consistent with common VC investment facilitating informational exchanges in VC portfolios. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用当投资者持有相互冲突的商业机会股份时责任豁免的分阶段引入，作为对风险投资（VC）投资和董事网络的冲击。在法律变化之后，我们发现行业内风险投资和共同董事在初创企业董事会任职的情况有所增加。尽管存在租金提取的可能性，风险投资组合中的同行业初创企业通过筹集更多资本、减少失败和更成功地退出而受益。风险投资董事在其他初创企业董事会任职是与积极结果相关的主要机制，这与共同风险投资促进风险投资组合中信息交流相一致。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁边获取。

articles.title_en: Shareholder Monitoring through Voting: New Evidence from Proxy Contests
articles.title_cn: 通过投票进行的股东监督：来自代理权争夺的新证据
articles.abstract_en: We present the first comprehensive study of mutual fund voting in proxy contests. Among contests where voting takes place, passive funds are 10 percentage points less likely than active funds to vote for dissidents. The gap shrinks significantly when accounting for votes withheld from management nominees, settled contests, and votes by non-“Big-Three” fund families. Passive and active funds are equally informed about firm fundamentals, although passive funds view contest-related SEC filings more often than active funds during contests, in absolute levels and incrementally relative to noncontest periods. We conclude that passive funds are engaged shareholders in high-stakes voting events. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
articles.abstract_cn: 我们首次对代理权争夺中的共同基金投票进行了全面研究。在发生投票的争夺中，被动基金投票支持异议方的可能性比主动基金低10个百分点。在考虑了对管理层提名人的弃权票、和解争夺以及非“三大”基金家族的投票后，这一差距显著缩小。被动基金和主动基金对公司基本面的了解程度相同，尽管在争夺期间，被动基金查看与争夺相关的美国证券交易委员会文件的频率高于主动基金，无论是在绝对水平上还是在相对于非争夺期的增量上。我们得出结论，被动基金在高风险投票事件中是积极参与的股东。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁边获取。

articles.abstract_en: Hedge fund teams with heterogeneous educational backgrounds, academic specializations, work experiences, genders, and races, outperform homogeneous teams after adjusting for risk and fund characteristics. An event study of manager team transitions, instrumental variable regressions, and an analysis of managers who simultaneously operate solo- and team-managed funds address endogeneity concerns. Diverse teams deliver superior returns by arbitraging more stock anomalies, avoiding behavioral biases, and minimizing downside risks. Moreover, diversity allows hedge funds to circumvent capacity constraints and generate persistent performance. Our results suggest that diversity adds value in asset management. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
articles.abstract_cn: 具有不同教育背景、学术专长、工作经验、性别和种族的对冲基金团队，在调整风险和基金特征后，其表现优于同质化团队。对经理团队变动的事件研究、工具变量回归以及对同时管理独立和团队管理基金的经理的分析，解决了内生性问题。多元化团队通过利用更多股票异常、避免行为偏差和最小化下行风险来提供卓越回报。此外，多元化使对冲基金能够规避容量限制并产生持续的表现。我们的结果表明，多元化在资产管理中增加了价值。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接相邻处获取。
